purpose: Visual references required by the user before implementing additional views. Actual product behavior, controls, data and focus rules follow the reviewed spec. Generated incidental timestamps, extensions, track counts, durations, icons and surrounding app controls are not requirements.

images.prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop UI concept for TabPlayer, an original professional guitar notation editor. This is an implementation reference screenshot, not marketing artwork. 1280 by 900 composition, crisp legible system sans roughly13px, compact 28px controls, 3px corners. Background app is a dense charcoal music workstation (#171a20, #23272f panels, #434b59 subtle rules, #edf0f5 text, #b5bfcc secondary text, restrained #79aaff blue focus/selection) with a large cream music score behind ONE centered approximately900 by620 Library dialog. Top app chrome has File, View, Undo, Redo, Help, score tabs and compact Play/Stop transport. Original TabPlayer wordmark only, no vendor logos or copied screenshots. The Library dialog has left navigation Recent / Templates / Folders / Examples, clear main header and search when relevant, scrollable compact factual lists with readable metadata, bottom contextual path/status and explicit primary action plus Close. Keep the score visible around it. Flat functional desktop styling, no glass, no gradients, no decorative cards, no fake waveform or meters, no online store, no invented AI buttons. Fictional original score names only. UI must be a convincing cohesive real application, not wireframe. Selected section Recent. Heading 'Library', subtitle 'Recent scores'. Search scores field. Compact rows with title, artist, tracks and path, pin controls; one selected row 'Harbour Lights', artist 'Original ensemble', tracks 'Guitar · Bass · Drums', another 'Late Train', another clearly marked 'File missing' with Remove action. Separate subtle Welcome area with 'Start a new score' and links to Templates and Examples, not a second dialog. Footer selected local path, Open and Close. Present one polished usable primary state.
